definitions.sign_flip: the n values d_b (for the no-regression claim d_b minus the line) multiplied by each of the 2^n patterns of +1 and -1; count = the patterns whose mean lies at least as far from 0 as the measured mean (one-sided: at or under the measured mean); ties within 1e-12 counted; the smallest two-sided count is 2 of 2^n (the measured pattern and its mirror image)
definitions.line: floor(0.05 x 2^n): 12 of 256 for 8 bodies, 0 of 16 for 4 bodies
definitions.route_check: the recorded mean and interval recomputed from the saved per-body values with the original script's draws and generator seed: within 1e-12 of the value's size plus 1e-15 for a number recorded as a full binary float, the same printed digits for one recorded as text, equal counts and rounded lists; any difference beyond that makes the pass INVALID
definitions.interval_exclusions: beside, deciding nothing: of the 2^n sign-flipped sets, how many the original interval method excludes 0 for; a correct 95% interval would for 5 in 100 (12.8 of 256, 0.8 of 16)
definitions.words: CONFIRMED: n of 6 or more, values saved, route check held, the list reads neither assumption as failing or doubtful, count at most the line. NOT CONFIRMED: the same with the count above the line. NOT TESTABLE: n of 5 or fewer, values not saved, or an assumption read as failing or doubtful (entry 2.5), the count still written. INVALID: the route check failed.
